# Skyline Academic

> Skyline Academic provides AI-powered plagiarism detection, AI content detection, academic editing, proofreading, and live tutoring services for students and educators committed to academic integrity.

Founded in 2023 and based in Burlington, Ontario, Canada, Skyline Academic serves 200,000+ active users with free and premium tools for originality verification, AI detection, and personalized academic support. The platform combines automated detection technology with expert human feedback across essay checking, manuscript editing, and 1-on-1 tutoring.

## Core Detection Tools

- [Free Plagiarism Checker For Students [200K+ Active Users]](https://skylineacademic.com/free-plagiarism-checker): Free plagiarism detection tool with AI-powered matching engine for students and academics.
- [Free AI Detector For Essays, Students, & Teachers [200k Active Users]](https://skylineacademic.com/ai-content-detector): Free AI detector for essays identifying ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude content for academic integrity.
- [Plagiarism Detection](https://skylineacademic.com/plagiarism-detection): Free plagiarism detection tool with AI-powered matching engine for originality verification.
- [AI Detection](https://skylineacademic.com/ai-detection): Free AI detector for ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude detection ensuring academic integrity and originality.

## Writing & Editing Services

- [Academic Editing Services: Trusted By 200K Active Users](https://skylineacademic.com/academic-editing): Professional academic editing for essays, papers, and manuscripts with APA, MLA, Chicago compliance.
- [High-Quality Academic Proofreading Help | Skyline Academic](https://skylineacademic.com/academic-proofreading): Academic proofreading service for assignments to dissertations with grammar correction and citation verification.
- [Professional Assignment Help & Guidance | Skyline Academic](https://skylineacademic.com/assignment-coaching-feedback): Expert assignment coaching and feedback service with research guidance and AI-powered review.
